name: Unone Render Effects
description: Stylized full-screen passes for the official Web player: CRT, pixelate, film grain, chromatic aberration, posterize and ink outlines, installed as render_extensions.

tools.name: plugin.test
tools.title: Test the effect modules
tools.description: Load every effect module, check its metadata and run one draw against a recording THREE stand-in.

tools.name: effects.list
tools.title: List effects
tools.description: Every effect with its pass kind, summary, params, ranges and defaults.

tools.name: effects.plan
tools.title: Plan an install
tools.description: Show the files and JSON changes effects.apply would make for the chosen effects, without writing anything.

effects.description: Pass kinds such as fx.crt, or short names such as crt.

tools.name: effects.apply
tools.title: Install effects
tools.description: Copy the chosen effect modules to render/fx/, declare them in player.presentation.json render_extensions, and add disabled-by-default passes to project.unone.json render_pipeline. Refuses to overwrite a changed module unless force is true.

enabled.description: Add the passes enabled; default false, so game code turns them on with api.render.setPass.
